result.topic_en: Statements of Lagrange's series-inversion theorem and a related coefficient formula for the expansion of powers of a root of x = z/(1+ax^m+bx^{2m}+...), with marginal sketches of the complex plane.

1. Theorema La Grangianum.

Si $x=t+u\xi$ erit

$\varphi x=\varphi t+u\xi\varphi' x+\frac{uu}{2}\frac{d\xi^2\varphi' x}{dx}+\frac{u^3}{6}\frac{d^2\xi^3\varphi' x}{dx^2}+\&c.$
posito post diff: loco ipsius $x$, $t$.

2. Si $x=\frac{z}{1+ax^m+bx^{2m}+cx^{3m}+\&c.}=\frac{z}{X}$

erit $x^n$ formae $z^n+\mathfrak{A}z^{n+m}+\mathfrak{B}z^{n+2m}+\mathfrak{C}z^{n+3m}+\&c.$

et
$x^n$ coeffic: $z^{n+km}=\frac{n}{n+km}X^{-n-km}$ coeff $x^{km}$

methods.what: Lagrange inversion theorem: expansion of a function of x defined implicitly by x = t + u ξ(x) as a power series in u
methods.quote:
$\varphi x=\varphi t+u\xi\varphi' x+\frac{uu}{2}\frac{d\xi^2\varphi' x}{dx}+\frac{u^3}{6}\frac{d^2\xi^3\varphi' x}{dx^2}+\&c.$
posito post diff: loco ipsius $x$, $t$.

methods.what: Form of the series for x^n when x = z/X with X a series in x^m
Coefficient formula (Lagrange inversion): coefficient of z^{n+km} in x^n equals n/(n+km) times the coefficient of x^{km} in X^{-n-km}
